title.narrative: European Union for Improving Environmental Monitoring in the Black Sea - EU4EMBLAS

description.narrative: This Action aims to support selected members of the Black Sea Synergy to align their policies and actions with the EU Marine Strategy Framework Directive (MFSD). The contract will enable further action for improving environmental monitoring systems and will build upon work under previous phases of EMBLAS. Special focus will be put on helping Georgia and Ukraine to strengthen their laboratory capacity for marine environment monitoring.
